'''Chan Dash''' was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] who lived during the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] era. On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], he sought to help from the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jax Pavan]] and his team.<ref name="CN3" />
